subject: Child Development & Pedagogy
stem: Before providing career guidance, a school maintains a detailed cumulative record of each student's academic performance, attendance, health, interests, and participation across all years, allowing counsellors to make informed, individualised recommendations. This record is called a:
explanation: A cumulative record card compiles a comprehensive, longitudinal profile of a student across years — academic, health, and behavioural data — supporting well-informed guidance decisions, unlike a single anecdotal note or rubric.
